coverageEvidence.excerpt: The KEYNOTE-522 card concerns previously untreated stage II or III triple-negative breast cancer and a whole preoperative and postoperative strategy. Four three-week cycles of paclitaxel and carboplatin preceded four with an anthracycline and cyclophosphamide, followed by surgery and up to nine assigned pembrolizumab or placebo cycles. The planned blocks span about 12, 12 and 27 dosing weeks: eight plus nine gives up to 17 assigned doses, approximately a year, with the surgical gap and holds affecting the actual calendar. Its first-602 pCR result, all-1,174 survival analyses and treatment-related safety results have distinct denominators and cutoffs. Radiation indications and the actual breast and node procedures require their own entries. The trial calendar is not a personal administration record.

coverageEvidence.excerpt: The final overall-survival analysis published in 2024 used a March 22, 2024 cutoff and median follow-up of 75.1 months. Estimated 60-month OS was 86.6% versus 81.7%, with the paper reporting P=0.002; the label reports an OS hazard ratio of 0.66 (95% confidence interval 0.50 to 0.87) for the prespecified analysis.
